Civilised luxury on a budget in a busy town What a lovely hotel, so location might not be in the middle of all the hustle and bustle of Bodrum but that makes this such a tranquil place and it is a 20-25 minute walk to the marina. The pool area is so lovely, at this time of year in early June, there are ample sunbeds, which are lovey, by the way. The breakfast is a buffet but excellent. The attached restaurant is an Italian, mainly pizza and pasta, but very good with white linen table clothes and excellent service and should be busier considering the quality. The rooms are nice but could be a little bigger bathroom and storage. You do get a pillow choice which is a godsend for me. Cleaning is excellent all over the hotel, staff seem all to be genuinely invested in the service the do and give. There is a lovely bar area which do the best cocktails I have had in Bodrum, though let them know you want a drink as you could be waiting a while sometimes. Overall I think at £106 per night this hotel offers great value and a little bit of civilised luxury in a what can a vibrant holiday town. Highly recommended.
